response.sql: WITH st AS (SELECT c.state_county_province AS state, COALESCE(SUM(ft.transaction_amount),0) AS total FROM Financial_Transactions ft JOIN Accounts a ON a.account_id = ft.account_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id GROUP BY c.state_county_province), sh AS (SELECT state, total, total * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(total) FROM st) AS share FROM st), av AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM sh) SELECT SUM(sh.total) AS combined_total, AVG(sh.share) AS avg_share, AVG(sh.share - av.avg_share) AS avg_excess FROM sh CROSS JOIN av WHERE sh.share > av.avg_share
